key.name: workspaces
key.description: Internal JSON-encoded store of extension-owned per-workspace counter state (label, estimate, and elapsed seconds), keyed by workspace index. Managed entirely by the extension and its D-Bus API; not meant to be edited by hand.

key.name: show-label
key.description: Show the generic workspace label (a descriptive workspace name) set via SetWorkspaceMetadata/PrepareWorkspace, in the top panel and/or the workspace switcher.

key.name: show-estimate
key.description: Show the reference estimate duration set via SetWorkspaceMetadata/PrepareWorkspace, in the top panel and/or the workspace switcher.

key.name: show-counter
key.description: Show the live elapsed-time counter, in the top panel and/or the workspace switcher.

key.name: show-panel
key.summary: Show the display in the top panel
key.description: Show the configured workspace label/estimate/counter as an indicator in the GNOME top panel.

key.name: show-workspace-switcher
key.summary: Show the display in the workspace switcher
key.description: Show the configured workspace label/estimate/counter alongside GNOME's workspace switcher popup.
